conflict.title: Another copy of Toskar Pro is running
conflict.message:
{{other}} is already running on this computer at the address this app needs ({{address}}), so this app can't start its own. The other one has its own models, chats, and settings.

Quit it and open this app again, or use the other one for now.
conflict.messageProcess:
{{other}} is already running on this computer at the address this app needs ({{address}}), so this app can't start its own. It isn't this app's service: it's process {{pid}}, {{command}}.

Stop it and start this app's own service?

conflict.programTitle: Another program is using Toskar Pro's address

Process {{pid}}, {{command}}, is using the address Toskar Pro needs ({{address}}), so Toskar Pro can't start.

Quit that program, then open Toskar Pro again.
conflict.programUnknown:

Quit the program using it, then open Toskar Pro again.

conflict.startFailed: Toskar Pro stopped the other service, but its own didn't start. Open Toskar Pro again.
